item.subject: maths
item.stem:
Naveen studies the three pictures in the figure. Each picture is a triangular array of dots: $1$ dot, then a triangle of $3$ dots, then a triangle of $6$ dots.

Which claim correctly describes how to draw the next picture?

options.A: The next picture is a triangular array of $10$ dots, because the pictures show $1$, $1+2$, $1+2+3$, then $1+2+3+4$ dots.
options.B: Any larger cluster of dots works, so the triangular row-by-row construction need not continue.
options.C: Drawing the next triangular array is what creates the earlier counts $1$, $3$ and $6$.
options.D: The next picture needs the full chapter shape-sequence table before it can be drawn.
